_meta.description: Simulated on-chain wallet balances. In production this comes from Fireblocks /v1/vault/accounts/{id}. Calibrated against Kraken's December 31, 2025 published Proof of Reserves for BTC, ETH, XRP (real anchors); USDC/USDT/SOL/ADA are deliberate test scenarios designed to exercise every branch of the Policy Outcome Decision Matrix. See docs/SOX-MAPPING.md, fixtures/README.md, and the agent registry row for fao_reserve_recon_v1.
_meta.fixture_design_principle: 3 PoR-anchored assets (real-world data shape) + 1 clean baseline + 3 synthetic anomalies (one per critical control path: FAO-REC-002, FAO-REC-004, FAO-REC-007). Single execution exercises ALLOW, ALLOW_WITH_OBLIGATIONS, REQUIRE_HUMAN STANDARD, and REQUIRE_HUMAN CRITICAL outcomes.

wallets._scenario: Calibrated to Kraken's Dec 31, 2025 published BTC reserve ratio of 100.3%. Reflects the documented posture shift from March 2025 (114.9%) — Kraken tightened buffer reserves materially. Falls below the configured ratio_band_lower of 1.05 but above the 1.00 floor. Expected policy outcome: ALLOW_WITH_OBLIGATIONS (drift from over-reservation posture; weekly review obligation).
Calibrated to Kraken's Dec 31, 2025 published ETH reserve ratio of 101.3%. Within the configured band [1.00, 1.10]. Expected policy outcome: ALLOW.
Exact match — exercises the in-band ALLOW path with zero discrepancy. Stablecoin band [1.0000, 1.0050] passed cleanly. Expected policy outcome: ALLOW.

Synthetic anomaly: ratio 1.0000549 sits within the tight stablecoin band [1.0000, 1.0050], BUT absolute USD discrepancy of $67,890.50 exceeds the USDT materiality threshold of $10,000. Stablecoin units are 1:1 USD; small ratio deviations on large pools are still material. Expected policy outcome: REQUIRE_HUMAN (STANDARD) per FAO-REC-002 USD-materiality breach.

Synthetic anomaly: under-reserved at 0.95 ratio, below the 1.00 floor. MATERIAL — wallet holdings insufficient to cover ledger liabilities. Expected policy outcome: REQUIRE_HUMAN (CRITICAL, 2 approvers required for RED-tier escalation) per FAO-REC-004 reserve ratio threshold check.
Calibrated to Kraken's Dec 31, 2025 published XRP reserve ratio of 100.6%. Within the configured band [1.00, 1.10]. Expected policy outcome: ALLOW.

Wallet looks normal at the asset level; however see ledger_data.json — ADA has a negative client_liabilities injection simulating the 'negative leaf' anomaly Kraken called out in krakendb (2014 reference implementation). Reserve ratio is undefined when liability is negative. Expected policy outcome: REQUIRE_HUMAN (CRITICAL) per FAO-REC-007 negative-liability detection.
